portal_description:
The java-1.7.0-openjdk packages provide the OpenJDK 7 Java Runtime Environment
and the OpenJDK 7 Java Software Development Kit.

This update fixes the following bug:

* Prior to this update, building the Apache Oozie workflow engine on the
little-endian variant of IBM Power Systems caused the Java virtual machine (JVM)
to terminate unexpectedly. This update ensures that a required argument that was
previously missing is now present in the appropriate function call of the
HotSpot interpreter, and thus prevents the described crash from occurring.
(BZ#1201393)

Users of java-1.7.0-openjdk are advised to upgrade to these updated packages,
which fix this bug. All running instances of OpenJDK Java must be restarted for
the update to take effect.
